name: Weather & Forecast Lookup
author: Helm Team
description: Instant current weather and multi-day forecast lookup via wttr.in and open-meteo (no API key required).

commands.title: Current Weather
commands.description: Look up real-time temperature, humidity, and conditions for any city

commands.title: Quick Weather Line
commands.description: Get an instant one-line weather summary for quick glance

tools.name: weather_get_current
tools.description: Fetch current weather conditions, temperature, humidity, and wind for a city or coordinates.

location.description: City name, zip code, or latitude,longitude (e.g. 'Tokyo', 'London', 'San Francisco')

tools.name: weather_get_forecast
tools.description: Fetch multi-day weather forecast with daily highs, lows, and conditions.

days.description: Number of forecast days (1 to 3, default: 3)

tools.name: weather_quick_summary
tools.description: Get a compact, one-line human readable weather summary for a location.
